items.description: Client must have any lien or notice of lien against Host's Property released and removed of record immediately.
items.span_text: Client shall cause it to be immediately released and removed of record (by payment, statutory bond or other lawful means)
items.trigger: in case of any such lien attaching or notice of any lien

items.description: Client must immediately pay Host's costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, incurred in removing a lien.
items.span_text: all sums, costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs, incurred by Host in connection with such lien shall be immediately be due and payable by Client

items.description: Client must ensure and instruct its personnel to follow Host's reasonable directions.
items.span_text: Client must ensure that and will instruct Client Personnel to follow any reasonable directions of Host

items.description: Host must install power consumption meters at the Data Center Facility to monitor power used by the Colocation Servers and MDC Infrastructure.
items.span_text: Host shall install Power Consumption Meter(s) at the Data Center Facility to monitor the electrical power consumed in the operation of the Colocation Servers and MDC Infrastructure

items.description: Client is responsible for its portion of the costs of replacement parts used in routine maintenance or repairs of the Colocation Servers.
items.span_text: Client shall be responsible for their portion of the costs of replacement parts to be installed in or used with the Colocation Servers in connection with any routine maintenance or repairs required to service the Colocation Servers.

items.description: Host must provide documents and information supporting an insurance claim for damaged or lost Colocation Servers when Client requests.
items.span_text: Host shall provide Client and/or the owner of the Colocation Servers (as applicable) with documents and information in support of the insurance claim made to the insurance company, as requested by Client.

items.description: Client must reimburse Host's reasonable third-party costs of preparing or delivering insurance claim documents when those costs are material.
items.span_text: Client shall reimburse Host’s reasonable costs and expenses actually expended on third parties for the preparation or delivery of such documents and information, if such costs and expenses are material
items.trigger: if such costs and expenses are material

items.description: Client must obtain and maintain the insurance coverage a prudent owner of the Colocation Servers would carry.
items.span_text: Client shall obtain and maintain all relevant insurance policy or coverage that a prudent owner of the Colocation Servers would obtain.

items.description: Each party must indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other party against specified third-party claims.
items.span_text: Each Party (the “Indemnifier”) shall indemnify, defend and hold the other Party (the “Indemnitee”)

items.description: A party claiming indemnity must promptly give written notice of the potential loss and the breach, act or omission causing it.
items.span_text: Any Party claiming to be an Indemnitee shall promptly notify the Indemnifier in writing of the potential Loss, and the breach, act or omission which lead to the Loss

items.description: Host must indemnify Client for damage or loss of a Colocation Server caused solely by Host, based on fair market value.
items.span_text: if any Colocation Server is damaged or lost due to reasons solely attributable to Host, Host hereby agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless Client and its respective Affiliates, officers, directors, agents and employees from and against any damage or loss of a Colocation Server, based on the fair market value of such Colocation Server.
items.trigger: if any Colocation Server is damaged or lost due to reasons solely attributable to Host
